tier_definitions.clear: An asserted negative appraisal of Putin personally, or conduct/intent/capability unambiguously assigned to him. Explicit shared blame/capability judgments include him; clear does not mean harsh or exclusive.

tier_definitions.separate: State/war/situation-only appraisal, unattributed attack criticism, request, conditional pressure, outcome-only disappointment, broad collective dismissal, or ambiguous actor attribution. These may be negative rhetoric but do not meet the actor-negative tiers.
